versions.changelog:
- Removed the file skill-card.md from the project.
- Updated documentation to reflect a new default model: Mano-ASR-0.8B-Instruct-1.0-MLX-8bit (~1GB), replacing Qwen3-ASR-1_7B-8bit (~1.7GB).
- Revised environment check and model management sections to use the new default model and output examples.
- Adjusted first-time model download size notes (now ~1GB instead of 1–2GB).
- Cleaned up and clarified documentation for installation, CLI usage, service management, and troubleshooting.
- No functional or code changes; update is documentation-focused.

mano-asr 1.0.0 – First public release

- Provides fully offline, zero-cost speech-to-text (ASR) for OpenClaw on Apple Silicon Mac, powered by Qwen3-ASR or Fun-ASR-Nano models on MLX.
- No cloud API keys required; all audio handled locally for maximum privacy.
- Supports common audio formats: .wav, .mp3, .ogg, .webm, .m4a, .flac.
- Seamless integration with OpenClaw across all supported channels (WeCom, Telegram, Discord, Signal, WebChat, etc.).
- Includes CLI tools for service control, configuration, model selection, troubleshooting, and direct audio transcription.
- Offers detailed setup, configuration, troubleshooting instructions, and support for advanced features like hotwords, dual backend (local & cloud), and fine-grained access control.
